{
  "description": "TileServer GL is a map tile server that serves vector and raster tiles using MapLibre GL Native for server-side rendering. It supports various input formats including MBTiles, PMTiles, and remote URLs, and exposes tiles via standard HTTP endpoints compatible with clients like Leaflet, OpenLayers, and MapLibre GL JS.",

      "confidence": 0.8,
      "evidence_refs": [
        "README.md@19a8df21",
        "src/main.js@19a8df21"
      ],
      "notes": "The server manages multiple map styles/layers defined in configuration files (config.json) or passed via CLI. It serves vector tiles and rasterized tiles for these layers. However, it does not provide a dynamic API to add/remove/modify layers at runtime; the layer configuration is static based on the startup config."
